decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own dedicated page, which signals it is a core new offering the firm is actively promoting, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
Hyaluronic acid serums are a steady-demand category and the product only launched in 2023, so a small cosmetics maker would normally give it more time despite its modest web presence.
A cleansing milk is a low-cost basic that rounds out the facial care range and costs little to keep, so dropping it so soon after launch is unlikely.
